svg.title: Bytes downloaded on the first load of the same counter app, compressed with brotli, drawn to one linear scale. Angular 22.2: 30.0 kilobytes. React 19.3 with Vite: 58.6 kilobytes. Flutter 3.47 web, WebAssembly build: 1,738.7 kilobytes. Flutter 3.47 web, JavaScript build: 2,064.0 kilobytes. The two DOM-based apps are barely visible next to Flutter's, which must also download its rendering engine.
svg.text: Brotli-compressed bytes on first load, one linear scale (kB = 1,000 bytes)
Flutter's figure includes its engine (CanvasKit or skwasm, about 1.2 to 1.5 MB compressed)
and a font; the DOM frameworks rely on the browser to draw and to supply fonts.
